race.comment: DR. PATRICK (2) jumped well and was in the mix early before fading out of it late when 7th over 350m at this track in Bottom Up - Grade 5 company. Remains without a win from the draw but has been in the placings four times from six attempts. Has ability and is a key runner. IT'S FRIDAY (1) scored (25.43) last time out over 435m at Sale nine weeks ago. Form at the trip sound including four wins. Will go close here with a clear run. ASTON BENTLEY (3) has missed the placings at his last couple but was in the money three back when third (23.23) at Warragul in a Bottom Up - Grade 5. Rates a winning chance on best. SNAPPER HEAD (8) scored an unexpected win last time. Don't underestimate. Something for the Multiples: JUMBUK JOZEF (5)
